outcome: Change in rate of early-term nonindicated births over time
Patient characteristics associated with early-term nonindicated births
Infant outcomes associated with early-term nonindicated births
cohort: 7,296,363 uncomplicated births (>37 0/7 wk' gestation) between 1995 and 2009 in 3 states
finding: Nearly 4% of all uncomplicated births to term infants occurred before 39 0/7 weeks' gestation without medical indication, and these births were associated with adverse infant outcomes.
mod_finding: Early-term nonindicated cesarean birth was associated with greater odds of prolonged length of stay and infant respiratory distress compared with births after 38 6/7 weeks, and early-term nonindicated induction was also associated with comparatively greater odds of prolonged length of stay.
